primary_effort: Revisit slightly greater self-generated vertical landing momentum while holding the two-set rebound dose fixed.
readiness_gate: The E3 amplitude option requires actual clean 2 × 3 vertical rebounds at the familiar amplitude (4/4 organized transitions, 2/2 final holds), acceptable subsequent response and current readiness. Set 1 today must remain organized; only then may set 2 use one small coach-selected height step. Missing evidence means both sets stay at familiar controllable height. Independently, E4 requires actual qualified forward rebounds and recovery; otherwise use its held broad-jump replacement. No new height, distance, sequence length or strength load is added elsewhere.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 jumps. 20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Retain a small bilateral braking reference before single-leg acceptance. Use a controllable vertical jump, coordinated ankle/knee/hip yielding and a 2 s hold. Lower height for stepping or trunk collapse.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 6 low jumps**, continuous. **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Prepare low-amplitude ankle return without tiring the receiving legs. Stay tall, knees soft and feet centered; settle the last contact. Reduce amplitude or stop for heavy contacts/knee pumping.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — three connected jumps, conditional amplitude change
explosive.dose: **2 × 3 jumps = 6 landings / 4 transitions.** Set 1 at the documented familiar amplitude; set 2 may use one small increase only if the gate is met. **120 s between sets and before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary anchor:** retain a prompt, organized reversal under a modest change in self-generated incoming momentum. Use natural arm swing, necessary joint yielding and a 2 s final hold. Do not add a gathering dip or force rigid legs. Return to familiar height for collapse, drift or visibly delayed reversal; no replacement test attempts.
explosive.kind: moderate bilateral vertical rebound; optional amplitude change

explosive.name: Repeated Broad Jump — two connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 2 jumps = 4 landings / 2 forward rebound transitions. 120 s between sets and before E5.**
explosive.job: Consolidate a separately qualified forward landing-to-takeoff pattern at a small dose. Use modest displacement and natural arm swing, continuous reversal without a gather and a 2 s final stop. Shorten distance or use held broad jumps if reaching or uncontrolled travel appears.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — stick landing
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 receiving landings per leg = 4 bounds.** Alternate sides, **20 s between bounds; 90 s before E6.**
explosive.job: Keep lateral single-leg force acceptance without adding lateral return demand while vertical amplitude is the candidate change. Use the familiar small distance and hold each landing 2 s. Shorten for knee collapse, pelvis drop or corrective hops.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 low hops per leg = 6 hops. 60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Keep a minimal but real one-leg ankle rhythm exposure while directional practice shares the session. Stay centered over the foot with a softly organized knee; settle the third hop. Use lower amplitude/support or stop if alignment or rhythm is lost.

replacement_routes.description: Familiar-amplitude E3 has the same 28 landings, 18 bilateral + 10 single-leg, 46 limb contacts and 15 transitions as the listed route. Holding E4 forward jumps keeps 28 landings but gives 13 transitions and adds 30 s (280 versus 250 s).

E3 two-jump regression gives 26 landings, 16 bilateral + 10 single-leg and 42 limb contacts; transitions are 13 with connected forward work or 11 with held forward jumps. E3 time falls approximately 2 s.

next_intended_job: Class 10 may extend the familiar vertical sequence by one jump per set only after actual three-jump quality and recovery; amplitude and strength loads must stay fixed.
